notes: Round 57, curated. Cambodia's statute gives verification to the bank's OWN Board and to the National Audit Authority; the record is filed to the Audit Authority alone, with the full statutory wording in the detail, because a record naming the bank's own Board would say the bank audits itself -- the Macao and Iran pattern, which this map treats as a structural blank rather than an external auditor.

records.name_as_stated: DELOITTE & CO S.A. y DELOITTE PARAGUAY S.R.L. Consorcio Internacional
records.detail: The Banco Central del Paraguay's board awarded the external audit of the bank's accounting and budget statements to a consortium of Deloitte & Co S.A. and Deloitte Paraguay S.R.L. by Resolucion N 2, Acta N 50 of 7 November 2025, under international public tender LPI N 17/2025, covering the financial years 2025, 2026 and 2027; the award is published on Paraguay's national public procurement portal as contract LI-21001-25-262420.
records.source_title: Banco Central del Paraguay, award of international public tender LPI N 17/2025 for the external audit (Direccion Nacional de Contrataciones Publicas)

records.as_of: standing statutory mandate under Law 23 of 2002; the law states no financial year
records.detail: Syria names no private audit firm for its central bank: article 68(3) of Basic Monetary Law No. 23 of 2002, published by the Central Bank of Syria on its own legislation page, gives the auditing of the bank's records and accounts to the Central Organization for Financial Control, the country's supreme audit institution, within the limits of that body's own law. No financial year is stated and the bank's published reports carry no independent auditor's report.
records.source_title: Basic Monetary Law No. 23 of 2002, article 68(3) (Central Bank of Syria)

records.as_of: standing statutory mandate since the amending law of 29 December 2006
records.detail: Cambodia names no private audit firm for its central bank. Article 57-New, inserted by the law of 29 December 2006 amending the Law on the Organization and Function of the National Bank of Cambodia, says the financial records of the central bank shall be verified by the Board of the National Bank of Cambodia and the National Audit Authority, the country's supreme audit institution. The external half of that is the Audit Authority; the Board is an organ of the bank itself. No financial year is stated.
records.source_title: Law amending articles 14 and 57 of the Law on the Organization and Function of the National Bank of Cambodia, 29 December 2006, article 57-New (National Bank of Cambodia)
